title: A Day at the Beach
content: Last Saturday, my friends and I went to the beach. The weather was sunny and warm. We swam in the sea and built sandcastles on the sand. For lunch, we ate sandwiches and drank cold juice. In the afternoon, we played volleyball. It was a wonderful day and we enjoyed it very much.

What did they do after swimming?

title: My Favorite Season
content: My favorite season is autumn. The weather is cool and comfortable. The leaves on the trees turn yellow, orange and red, so the parks look very beautiful. I often go for a walk with my parents on weekends. We also pick apples on a farm nearby. Autumn is a wonderful time of the year.

questions.question: Why does the writer like autumn?

title: Healthy Eating Habits
content: Eating well is important for your body. You should eat more fruit and vegetables and drink enough water every day. Try not to eat too much fast food or sweet drinks. A healthy breakfast gives you energy for the whole morning. Remember to eat a little at a time, and do not skip meals.

questions.question: What gives you energy for the morning?
Which should you try NOT to eat too much?

title: A Trip to the Zoo
content: Last summer, my family visited the city zoo. We saw many animals, including elephants, lions and penguins. The elephants were very big and friendly. My little brother loved the monkeys because they were funny and played with each other. We took many photos and had lunch at the zoo cafe. It was a long day, but everyone was happy. I want to go back again next year.

questions.question: Which animal did the little brother love?
They had lunch at a restaurant outside the zoo.

title: My Best Friend
content: My best friend is Li Hua. We are in the same class at school. Li Hua is tall and has short black hair. He is very kind and always helps me with my homework. After school, we often ride our bikes to the park and play basketball together. On weekends, we sometimes go to the bookshop. I am lucky to have such a good friend.

questions.question: What do they do after school?
Where do they sometimes go on weekends?

title: Learning to Cook
content: Last month, I decided to learn how to cook. My grandmother taught me how to make tomato egg soup. First, I washed the tomatoes and cut them into small pieces. Then I cooked the eggs in hot water. Finally, I added some salt and sugar. The soup tasted delicious. Now I cook for my family every weekend. Cooking is a useful skill and I enjoy it very much.

What did the writer add at the end? Please answer in English.

title: My First Day at a New School
content: Today was my first day at a new school. I was very nervous in the morning. My teacher, Mr. Wang, was friendly and showed me around the school. The classroom was big and bright. I met three new classmates during break time. They were nice and invited me to play with them. I ate lunch in the school cafeteria. The food was good. By the end of the day, I was no longer afraid. I think I will like this school.

questions.question: How did the writer feel in the morning?
The classroom was small and dark.
Did the writer enjoy the first day? Why or why not? Please answer in English.
questions.modelAnswer: Example: Yes, because the teacher was friendly and the classmates were nice.

title: My New Phone
content: I got a new phone for my birthday. It is black and has a big screen. I can use it to take photos, listen to music and chat with my friends. My parents said I should not use it too much. I must finish my homework before I can play on my phone. I also set an alarm on my phone to wake me up in the morning. It is very useful.

title: Spring Festival
content: Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China. Families get together and have a big dinner on New Year's Eve. We eat dumplings and fish. Children receive red envelopes with money inside. People put up red decorations on their doors. During the holiday, we visit relatives and friends. Everyone wears new clothes and says Happy New Year. There are also fireworks and lion dances in the streets. It is my favorite time of the year.

questions.question: Children get green envelopes during Spring Festival.

What do people do on New Year's Eve? Please answer in English.
questions.modelAnswer: Example: Families get together and have a big dinner.

title: My Hobby: Painting
content: I started painting two years ago when my aunt gave me a set of watercolors. At first, I was not very good, but I practiced every weekend. Now I can paint flowers, trees and even animals. My favorite thing to paint is the sunset. I often paint in the park near my home. My teacher displayed one of my paintings in the school art show last month. Painting makes me feel calm and happy.

content: Anna goes to the supermarket. She wants to buy some rice and a cup of tea. The food costs two dollars. After shopping, she goes home by bus.

title: 我的宠物
content: Tom has a bird at home. It is green and very friendly. Every day Tom gives it some water. In the evening, they go for a walk to the school. Tom loves a bird very much.

title: 愉快的一天
content: Ben gets up early and goes to the park with his friends. They eat a sandwich for lunch there. In the afternoon they play games. Ben thinks it is a happy day.
